project.title: TopoFix — auditable repair solutions
project.subtitle: Reviewed work, InputXML repair, hub-screen review, Owner merge decisions and safety holds.
project.aim: TopoFix gives safe automatic fixes and clear, auditable review directions otherwise. A questioned CLOS-declared end about 240 mm away can be explained but never auto-joined. Every pipe-model format enters one Universal XML hub; TopoFix works there, then qualified results are patched into the original format.

M1.name: Auditable disposition of current cases
M1.full: WP-A: explain each engineering case, reconcile all 66 proposals and preserve source meaning. The engineer sees what the 40-action batch changed, what remains, why actions were excluded and the supported next operation. IR assesses the current preservation gap before a bounded repair.
M1.canDo: Planned engineering outcome; completion is not inferred from evidence or task counts.

M3.full: WP-C: offer auditable safe Auto fix results or precise manual-review/repair directions, then strictly reimport an actual authorized S1, rerun complete TopoFix and reconcile original, outstanding, new and regressed cases.

M32.name: Manual Fix by rule and second pass
M32.full: WBS 3.2.1: collapsed Manual Fix rule groups and source cases. 3.2.2: exact physical partner selection by list or canvas. 3.2.3: source-bound movement preview and explicit approval for a selected connection, including >25 mm. 3.2.4: atomic Apply, full recheck, updated counts/canvas and downloadable connection receipts. Preserve existing manual guidance and unchanged automatic <=25 mm policy; unsupported or incompatible cases retain concrete source-review directions.
